title: Branched surfaces and triangulations — Question 7.3
exact_target: Determine every boundary slope carried by essential laminations of a given taut ideal triangulation, and give an algorithm.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300018 (AMR-102-0018). CC BY 4.0.
